decisions.reason: This air fin cooler sits close to the core offer and the firm has put engineering and its website presence behind it, so with no evidence of lasting failure management keeps it.
This core air-cooled condenser is publicly listed and fits the efficiency direction the firm has announced, and any weak early results can still be blamed on the launch phase.
Although this condenser overlaps with Product B, which raises some risk of consolidation, it rests on shared investment and visible commitment, so dropping it would mean admitting a misjudgment.
The tube liner extends the lifecycle-service strategy the firm has made central to its direction, so it stays.
Customized air coolers embody the integrated-solutions positioning the firm has publicly committed to, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The tube end repair inserts support the firm's announced service business and need little ongoing cost to keep.
